8.3.13 BswM_EthSM_CurrentState
[SWS_BswM_00050] Definition of API function BswM_EthSM_CurrentState
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_09228
⌈
Service Name
BswM_EthSM_CurrentState
Syntax
void BswM_EthSM_CurrentState (
NetworkHandleType Network,
EthSM_NetworkModeStateType CurrentState
)
Service ID [hex]
0x0d
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
Network
The Ethernet channel that the indicated state corresponds to.
Parameters (in)
CurrentState
The current state of the Ethernet channel.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
None
Description
Function called by EthSM to indicate its current state.
Available via
BswM_EthSM.h
⌋
[SWS_BswM_00081]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00406
⌈If the BswMDevErrorDetect switch is enabled, the routine shall check if the
BSW Mode Manager is initialized.
In case of an error, the BswM shall ignore the
state indication and report the error to the Default Error Tracer with the error code
BSWM_E_UNINIT.⌋
[SWS_BswM_00097]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00323
⌈If the BswMDevErrorDetect switch is enabled, the parameter CurrentState shall
be checked for being in the allowed range. In case of an error, the BswM shall ig-
nore the state indication and report the error to the Default Error Tracer with the value
BSWM_E_REQ_MODE_OUT_OF_RANGE.⌋
